metadata.title: LLM Chat bug fixes and improvements
metadata.author: kevalmahajan

description: # 🐛 Bug-fix PR ## 📌 Summary Closes #1707 and some feature improvements 1. Fixed all virtual servers tagged as inactive in LLM Chat. 2. Fixed scrolling issue with agent output is streamed in the Chat box. 3. Added support for markdown rendering for the streamed output from the AI. 4. Fixed Backend LLM configuration for LLM Chat supporting the new LLM Settings configurations. 5. Refined several UI elements for a cleaner look, improving usability and increasing space for the chat box. --- ### 📓 Logs / Changes Output **Earlier:** --- **Now:** ## 🧪 Verification | Check | Command | Status | |---------------------------------------|----------------------|--------| | Lint suite | `make lint` | | | Unit tests | `make test` | | | Coverage ≥ 90 % | `make coverage` | | | Manual regression no longer fails | steps / screenshots | | ## 📐 MCP Compliance (if relevant) - [ ] Matches current MCP spec - [ ] No breaking change to MCP clients ## ✅ Checklist - [ ] Code formatted (`make black isort pre-commit`) - [ ] No secrets/credentials committed
